retrievalProfile.description: A soft-focus portrait set against a bright, snowy mountain backdrop with prominent lens flare and top-centered outlined text.
triggerTerms: snowy mountain backdrop with lens flare

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered medium-shot portrait of a woman with wavy hair, bathed in a warm, hazy lens flare that creates a soft-focus effect. The background consists of bright, overexposed snowy mountains under a pale sky. The composition is topped with a single line of outlined, rounded typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm lens flare contrasting with cool blue-white snow
Subject centered against a vast, bright landscape
Text positioned in the upper margin to avoid obscuring the subject
Soft focus on the subject blending into the hazy background
coreInvariants: Prominent pink and white circular lens flare artifacts
Outlined display typography at the top edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes, framed by the lens flare.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-centered text down to the subject's face, then outward to the mountain horizon.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant bright negative space in the upper third and sides provided by the sky and snow.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool whites and pale blues (background and clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low to medium saturation; overall bright and airy feel.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to pastel and high-key tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Rounded sans-serif with uniform stroke width
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both artist and title for a cohesive, quiet look.
graphicDevices: Thin stroke outline on text to ensure legibility against bright sky

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rounded, friendly, and geometric skeleton of the original.
Provides the necessary soft terminals and clean legibility.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key photograph of a woman with wavy hair in a white dress, centered against a bright snowy mountain range. Apply a heavy soft-focus filter and add circular pink/white lens flares over the subject's face and hair.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the text in a rounded sans-serif font at the top center. Set the fill to transparent and add a thin, dark-blue outline.

verificationChecks: Is the text outlined and transparent?
Is there a visible lens flare effect?
Is the background a bright, snowy landscape?
Is the overall image high-key and soft-focus?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the lens flare does not obscure the eyes completely.
Ensure the text outline is visible against the sky.
Confirm the color palette remains cool with warm accents.
recipe.reuseFormula: Ethereal Portrait = (High-Key Snowy Landscape + Soft-Focus Subject) + (Warm Lens Flare Overlay) + (Top-Centered Outlined Rounded Typography)
